newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian shares driven up by sole stock.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian shares driven up by sole stock.

text.p: Livestock and Poultry pushed the Amman bourse 0.22 percent higher in otherwise thin trade dominated by investor apathy, dealers said.

"The market's volume explains the state of the market..with investor sentiment low because of the continued slide in prices," said Husam al-Hanbali, head of the Arab Banking Corporation's brokerage arm.
Brokers said depressed investor sentiment continued to depress the market with renewed selling pressure surfacing again in the absence of any new factors to reactivate declining turnover this month.

The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index rose 0.35 points to 156.11 points in low turnover of 249,483 dinars ($352,377). Most of the activity was focused on small deals with the largest in LIPO not exceeding trade worth 39,000 dinars.
Shareholder activity on Livestock and Poultry pushed it up by the five percent daily maximum. The shares rose 0.03 dinars to 0.59 dinars in low trade worth 39,127 dinars.

The two other more heavily traded stocks on Sunday posted modest gains: Jordan Cement Factories rose 0.04 dinars to 3.51 dinars in trade worth 31,000 dinars. Arab Pharmaceutical Manufacturing rose 0.03 dinars in trade worth 16,000 dinars.
Fifteen stocks fell and another 15 rose on Sunday, while nine traded but closed unchanged.
The private Pearl Index of the 45 most-traded shares on the exchange rose 0.05 percent to 81.68 points, 2.05 percent down from the start of the year.
